section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the added virtue of ten people sitting and studying Torah together, where each contributes his own understanding, and the collective study brings a new dimension of the public.
section.t: And based on this, we can add another matter regarding the virtue of ten who sit and engage in Torah,
since their opinions are not equal85,
each of the ten has his own explanation
(regarding the subject they are studying),
and by studying together, each one stating his explanation to the participants in the lesson,
there is also the virtue of engaging in Torah with another.
And another matter in this,
that by ten Jews engaging in one matter,
whether in Torah, prayer, or the fulfillment of a mitzvah,
a new element is added to them—the element of the public86,
a light that transcends them all87.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that when one comes to purify others, assistance is given immediately upon the intention, and those who devote themselves to the Rebbe's mission receive added strength to succeed.
section.t: A)
And the language of our Sages is: "One who comes to purify is assisted."
That when one comes to purify others,
the assistance is given immediately when he comes to purify.
And from this it is understood,
that all those who have devoted themselves to fulfilling the mission of the Baal HaGeulah in general,
and particularly in the mission88
to establish public lessons,
that through the devotion itself
(throwing themselves into the work,
even before the actual deed)
additional assistance and empowerment are drawn to succeed even more in fulfilling the mission.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section expresses the wish that through devotion to the Rebbe's mission, we will merit the true and complete redemption immediately, especially on this auspicious day.
section.t: And may it be His will,
that through the devotion and dedication to fulfilling the mission of the Baal HaGeulah,
and especially when one is already in the midst of it,
and "G-d is with me"
(for each of those involved in this)
as my helpers to complete the mission with utmost perfection,
we will immediately merit the true and complete redemption through our righteous Moshiach.
And since we are now on an auspicious day—the third day89
which was doubled with "it was good"90,
and the fifteenth day of the month of redemption, in which the moon stands in its fullness91
(the perfection of the month of redemption),
the merit of the auspicious day will hasten92
the redemption even more,
speedily in our days, literally.
